places.adresse: Rue de l'Île de Zembretta, Les Berges du Lac II, Tunis, Tunisie
places.notes: Commercial shopping centre, not a designated emergency shelter. Google Maps and the website's weekly table list 08:00-21:00 daily; the website FAQ gives different hours. The website describes air conditioning, a food court and accessibility. Free drinking-water supply, permission to rest without a purchase, shaded resting facilities and the full accessible route remain unconfirmed.
